item.title: Fail fast to learn fast
item.description: Just try it out, make it work, or don’t. Fail as fast as you can, and change directions as necessary. Embrace the failure as a great opportunity to learn.

item.title: Mahindra - Storage Box
item.description: When I bought Mariana, it came with two tools boxes and a dog box. Our first camping trip with her was using this setup. And It was not bad. The tool boxes made it all easy to organise.

item.title: Mahindra - Replacing Auto to Manual Locking Hubs
item.description: TLDR: You can use Nissan Safari/Patrol GQ Manual locking hubs on Mahindra. It’s easy to swap. Why? After Changing Mahindra wheel bearings, brake rotors and brake pads and tie rod, we went off-roading to Red Rocks, and while going up the Devil’s Gate we heard a big bang and the 4WD wouldn’t work anymore.

item.title: Fixing snapped CV Axle - Mahindra
item.description: After Mahindra - Replacing Auto to Manual Locking Hubs, I realised the problem was a bit worse. The CV axle actually popped out from the diff. NO! Even worse, it actually snapped inside of the diff! Diagnosing I’ve got some tips from Plimmerton Motors.

item.title: You write code for others, not for yourself
item.description: You are writing your code for others to read, understand and make sense of it. Even if you are working by yourself in a cave, yourself 6 months for now is not the same as yourself form today.

item.title: Take the context and constraints into consideration
item.description: Rules are for guidance, not to take religiously. Take your current context and constraints into consideration when building anything.

item.title: Coding for change
item.description: Don’t lie to yourself, your code is going to change, and you need to code expecting it to change. Make it easier to change. Remember that A bad abstraction is worse than no abstraction.

item.title: Build on top of a stable base
item.description: Building something? Check your base, it needs to be stable before you add something else at the top of it. Don’t cut corners, everything might fall apart!.
